description.value:
Duration constant

Hot Loading no longer widens your Failure Range at all — you may overcharge every shot you fire, for free, forever. When you do roll a Gun Failure, treat the result as one lower, to a minimum of 1. The die that ends other people’s fights is now a rounding error in yours.

cinderfall.incomplete: depends on the unencoded Hot Load mechanic (see hot-load below) and further modifies the homebrew Gun Failure Table. This effect is defined entirely in terms of a Cinderfall-homebrew subsystem with zero Foundry schema footprint (the Gun Failure Table/Failure Range, hazardous ground, time-in-sights, Trick Iron charge bank, or Drift/augment-slot cost). Confirmed via the full rule-element type listing (pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/, 40 files): no RollTable-manipulation, no persistent-terrain-hazard, and no arbitrary stacking-counter rule element type exists to hook any of these to. This card depends on (upgrades, extends, or is gated behind) another Ironsight card in this same package that itself ships rules: [] -- if the parent has nothing real to build on, the child has nothing real to extend either.
